title: kicad_specgen_local
description: Local machine configuration for KiCad SpecGen

schema_version.description: Schema version. Current: 1. Increment on breaking changes.

active_user.description: worker_id of the active user from kicad_specgen_users.json

kicad_cli_source.description: How kicad-cli was found: detected_macos_app (macOS app bundle), detected_linux_path (PATH or common Linux locations), detected_windows_path (Program Files or PATH), user_configured (manually set by user)

tokens.description: Local absolute path token definitions. Keys must match ^KSG_[A-Z0-9_]+$

KSG_APP_DIR.description: Root folder of the installed SpecGen application repository. Read-only: the application never writes here.

KSG_SYSTEM_CONFIG_DIR.description: OS KiCad user config folder containing kicad_specgen_local.json

KSG_COMPANY_DIR.description: Root containing the shared SpecGen/ folder. May be a Git repo root.

KSG_COMPANY_SPECGEN_DIR.description: Shared team SpecGen resources folder. Writable. Must not be inside KSG_APP_DIR.

KSG_COMPANY_COMMON_DIR.description: Shared team common assets folder. Writable. Must not be inside KSG_APP_DIR.

KSG_USER_SPECGEN_DIR.description: Individual user's SpecGen resource folder. Writable. Must not be inside KSG_APP_DIR.

KSG_USER_COMMON_DIR.description: Individual user's common templates and assets folder. Writable. Must not be inside KSG_APP_DIR.

dependency_stage.description: Highest completed dependency stage. stage1: PySide6+jsonschema. stage2: adds Jinja2. stage3: no new packages. stage4: adds WeasyPrint.

last_session.description: State of the application at last clean exit. Written on every exit. Per-project state (active tab, environment) is in the .kicad_specgen file.

specgen_project.description: Absolute path to the last opened .kicad_specgen file

project_name.description: project.name cached from the last opened .kicad_specgen (for display without re-opening)

display_name.description: project.display_name cached from the last opened .kicad_specgen (for display without re-opening)

kicad_project_dir.description: Absolute path to KICAD_PROJECT_DIR at last session (for display without re-opening)

window_geometry.description: Main window position and size at last exit. Machine-specific — correct to store here.

last_opened_at.description: Timestamp of the last project open event

recent_projects.description: Up to 10 recently opened SpecGen projects, most recent first. Per-project state (environment, active tab) is in each .kicad_specgen file and is not duplicated here.

project_name.description: project.name cached from the .kicad_specgen file (for display without re-opening)

display_name.description: project.display_name cached from the .kicad_specgen file (for display without re-opening)

kicad_project_dir.description: Absolute path to KICAD_PROJECT_DIR (for display in Open Recent submenu)

last_opened_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent open of this project

skipped_tokens.description: Token names suppressed on this machine via Missing Tokens dialog Skip option. Machine-local — does not affect other users. Cleared by the user from the Project tab.

preferences.description: User interface preferences. See SpecGen_GUI_Theme.md for theme specifications and colour palettes.

theme.description: Active UI theme. system: OS-adaptive (resolves to light or dark at runtime). Default when absent or unrecognised: dark. See SpecGen_GUI_Theme.md for full palette specifications.
